description:
I would like to bring to your attention the ongoing issue of irregular garbage collection at our apartment.

For the past two months, Laxmanan, the garbage collector assigned to our apartment, has been inconsistent in carrying out his duties. He has been collecting waste only on alternate days, causing inconvenience to residents and resulting in street dogs scattering garbage and creating unhygienic conditions in the surrounding area. We have raised this concern multiple times with his supervisor, Tirupathi. However, despite repeated follow-ups, the situation remains unchanged.

Therefore, I am escalating this complaint through this channel and request your intervention to ensure regular garbage collection and prevent further inconvenience to residents. Thank you for your support.
